description: This file declares data structures and function prototypes for preprocessing input speech in an AMR-NB speech codec. It includes definitions for initializing, resetting, exiting, and processing speech signals, and defines the Pre_ProcessState structure.

methods.name: Pre_Process_init
methods.description: Initializes a pre-processing state instance, allocating and setting up necessary resources.

methods.name: Pre_Process_reset
methods.description: Resets the pre-processing state to its initial zeroed state.

methods.name: Pre_Process_exit
methods.description: De-initializes and frees resources associated with the pre-processing state.

methods.name: Pre_Process
methods.description: Performs preprocessing on the input speech signal using the provided state.
